_comment: Public Signer with end-to-end encryption. public_signer_url: the public Signer (invite-only registration). No built-in TRON node: TRON reads go through the Signer, or straight to a node the human sets; EVM RPC defaults below (used for direct reads only), each overridable in Settings.
_tron_node: 0.3.9: there is no built-in TRON node. Reads go through the Signer unless the human sets a TRON node of their own (https; plain http only to localhost / a private network) — only then can reads go to it directly.
_evm_rpc_fallback: 0.3.12: official keyless public RPCs asked after the RPC above (or the human's own) when it errs or refuses (a provider may refuse fresh receipts)
